create_aa_names_lookup: create a lookup table from single letter amino acid codes to full names using AA_NAMES
build_standard_aa_tuple: build a tuple of the 20 standard single-letter amino acid codes from STANDARD_AA
test_aa_isoelectric_point: test the isoelectric point lookup for a given amino acid single-letter code in AA_TO_ISOELECTRIC_POINT
summarize_extended_amino_acids: summarize the 4 extended amino acid codes and their meanings from AA_NAMES
review_aa_indices: review the STANDARD_INDICES and EXTENDED_INDICES tuples that partition amino acid entries
